overloads.semanticRole: The Get plugin access command returns the name of the user group authorized to use the plug-in whose number was passed in the plugIn parameter.

constraints: plugIn is one of the 'Is License Available' theme plug-in constants (e.g. 4D Client SOAP license = 808465465, 4D Client Web license = 808465209, 4D for OCI license = 808465208, 4D ODBC Pro license = 808464946, 4D View license = 808465207, 4D Write license = 808464697) or a raw plug-in number.
Returns an empty string if no user group is associated with the plug-in.
